long_description:
Lofty is a marketplace that let's anyone sell a house to investors online. Instead of the typical real estate transaction where one seller sells to one buyer, Lofty is much more flexible.

Sellers fractionalize their equity ownership in the property into smaller units, so that anyone can buy a portion for as little as $50, allowing access to one of the best asset classes for people who have previously been locked out. Sellers can also sell a portion of their equity (starting at just 10%) instead of the entire property or create customized HELOC structures.

Investors can browse a variety of individual real estate properties ranging from commercial strip malls, a HELOC in someone's house, Airbnbs, to a single-family rental properties, and directly purchase ownership in these properties in under 5 minutes. There is no lockup period. Users can constantly trade these ownerships with others on the marketplace.

Investors truly legally own the properties they invested in and co-manage it with other investors through an online governance program. Owners have so far voted on how to handle various repairs, delinquent tenants, the sale of the underlying property, and much more.

Lofty never custodies or handles user funds or assets. Through smart-contracts on the blockchain, all transactions are directly peer-to-peer.

If we succeed, we'll have built the NASDAQ for real estate and transformed how real estate is bought and sold in the USA.

launches.tagline: A marketplace to buy and sell investment properties with instant liquidity.
launches.body:
## What is Lofty?

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81777&key=user_uploads/280486/b30729a4-1034-48ea-9ecc-0960d7862b2f)

[Lofty](https://www.lofty.ai) is a real estate marketplace, where people can buy and sell fractional ownership in real estate properties in seconds for as low as $50.

Anyone can come to list a property on Lofty for sale. We convert the equity of the property into tradable tokens on the blockchain through a process called "tokenization". They can then list as much or as little of it as they want for sale on the marketplace.

There are thousands of investors from around the world using Lofty to invest and build their own real estate portfolios. Many of them have also listed and sold partial ownership in properties they already owned (including their primary residences).

We’re the only platform that lets you buy AND sell fractional ownership with no restrictions or lock-up periods.

Now, we’re launching a new feature that allows you to instantly buy and sell ownership in properties without the requirement of a traditional counterparty.

For the first time in the world, you can now buy and sell equity in a house (grants you legal ownership + management control) with the same experience as trading a share of AAPL on Robinhood.

![uploaded image](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=81777&key=user_uploads/280486/f0e480b1-5df8-40d0-948d-4dbc35c9ebe0)

## How does ownership work?

Every property’s deed is legally held by a unique WY DAO LLC. Unlike a traditional LLC that has a centralized managing member/partner, these LLCs are algorithmically managed through smart-contracts on the blockchain.

Every member has equal power and voting rights based on how much of the LLC they own. So, by owning 10% of a DAO, you legally own 10% of the underlying property. The tokens/shares are legal representations of ownership in the LLC; whoever owns tokens of the LLC, also owns the LLC, which means they also own the property.

Co-ownership of properties is very common in the US and is no different than if you co-owned a house with family members or close friends. But instead of informally discussing how to manage things over the phone or in meetings, the management process is formalized through the “governance program”, where members vote on all management decisions. One token equals one vote and a super majority of 60% is required for any decisions to pass.

**We don’t manage your properties nor do we sell properties to you. Instead, you’re directly buying from and selling to other people on the platform. Your funds never touch our accounts** and you settle directly with each other using the blockchain through smart contracts. We don’t take a cut of your earnings or charge you management fees. Instead, we make a 6% transaction fee for every transaction on the platform. It’s split, so that the seller pays 3% and the buyer pays 3%.

* Now anyone can invest and actually legally own real estate for as little as $50.
* Anyone from around the world can participate; **you don’t have to be an accredited investor.**
* Our smallest users have invested $50 while our largest user has invested over $2,000,000.
* **No crypto understanding or experience needed, you can pay with credit cards or ACH transfers.**

# **To sign up, just create an account on **[**Lofty**](https://www.lofty.ai)**.**

## Examples of properties

**We have tokenized over 170 properties to date.** You can find almost any type of property on Lofty and we’re adding1 new property per week.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81777&key=user_uploads/280486/4352a64e-d17d-4547-b8b7-0c78afc91432)

* [A single-family house in Texas](https://www.lofty.ai/property_deal/1821-Donetto-Dr_Leander-TX-78641) being used as a standard long-term rental.
* [A single-family house in FL](https://www.lofty.ai/property_deal/122-Florida-Park-Dr_Palm-Coast-FL-32137) where the tenant has an option to rent-to-own and purchase the property from owners.
* [Cool ranch in CA](https://www.lofty.ai/property_deal/33008-Joshua-Ave_Acton-CA-93510), where the owner is basically doing a HELOC through Lofty.

  ![uploaded image](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=81777&key=user_uploads/280486/098a28ee-51eb-49cf-af21-0f5973c77c09)

* [Vacation rental cabin in CO](https://www.lofty.ai/property_deal/902-Karlann-Dr_Black-Hawk-CO-80422), short-term rental through Airbnb.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81777&key=user_uploads/280486/ac44e1f5-6dce-41de-9975-8bf811fe441f)

* [Parcel of Land in NY](https://www.lofty.ai/property_deal/6117-Hyde-Flats-Road-21_Black-Creek-NY-14714), where you can determine with your fellow co-owners to add more value by leasing out parts of it to solar companies and a local farmer.
* [Historic four-plex in upstate NY](https://www.lofty.ai/property_deal/88-Madison-Ave_Albany-NY-12202), all short-term rental units.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81777&key=user_uploads/280486/566c24c9-c8c7-4200-9329-d09df468ea57)

## Instant liquidity + lending

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81777&key=user_uploads/280486/67ce02ec-1476-4847-bf37-93d2621da70e)

We’re proud to introduce our [newest feature](https://amm.lofty.ai), the automated-market-maker and liquidity pools! You can read more in-depth about how this all works in our [learning center](https://learn.lofty.ai/en/collections/7492346-proactive-market-maker-pmm-liquidity-pools).

We took some concepts from decentralized exchanges (dexes) in the web3 world and adapted them to better fit a real world asset like a house.

**The algorithm borrows liquidity from people on the internet. It uses this borrowed liquidity to trade with Lofty users, which allows you to buy and sell ownership instantly without needing a traditional counterparty.**

The result is for the first time in the world, you can now directly buy and sell legal ownership in a specific property with the same speed and user experience as buying AAPL or TSLA on Robinhood.

On the other side, you can also now lend out your real estate ownership and/or money for yield. This is especially beneficial for lending out your real estate ownership, because you can continue to collect rental income from the property and vote on governance decisions, while also getting yield from lending.

**You can view our lending platform **[**here**](https://amm.lofty.ai)** and if you don’t have USDC (a stable coin) to lend out, no worries. We have our own on-ramps at Lofty and honor 1:1 exchange rates between USD and USDC. You can also directly convert USD to USDC on Coinbase, then send it to your Lofty account.**

This feature is completely opt-in. Some of our users only invest in real estate, some only lend out funds, while others interact with both.

## **Referral Credit**

If you refer a seller to our marketplace and they end up listing a property for sale, you'll receive a $1,000 cash referral bonus.

Additionally, if you refer anyone who spends $250 within the first month on the platform, you’ll both receive a $50 gift certificate to use on any property on the marketplace.

For any questions, feel free to reach out to us at [info@lofty.ai](mailto:info@lofty.ai) and follow along our journey to overhaul the real estate market on [X/Twitter](https://x.com/lofty_ai).

# [**👋**](https://emojipedia.org/waving-hand) Hi YC,

I’m Alex, founder of [Arpari](https://www.arpari.com/). Over the past 3 years, we’ve been working with commercial real estate finance teams to streamline their bank account data. We’ve built a multibank dashboard to provide a single login to teams working with hundreds of accounts across 10+ banks. 

💸 Today we’ve launched **multibank payments**, further reducing the need for teams to log into separate bank portals. Now, teams can fully manage their account inventory, reconcile transactions, and make transfers in a single dashboard.  

🚀 Recently, we have **expanded our focus beyond** real estate to satisfy all entity structures. Whether you are a small finance team with a simple account structure or you deal with hundreds of subsidiaries and entities and the complexity that brings, Arpari makes it easy to streamline your bank-related processes. 

# **TL;DR**

* Arpari centralizes account inventory, balances, and transactions across all your accounts, making month-end processes a breeze
* Our dashboard works with any number of banks and complex entity structures 
* Today, we launched payments so your team just needs to log into a single portal to set up and approve all payments to vendors, investors and anyone else
* Do you know any finance teams that work with more than one bank? Please introduce us! Email [Alexandra.zwiener@arpari.com](mailto:Alexandra.zwiener@arpari.com) or [book a demo here](https://www.arpari.com/book-demo)

  

# **❌ The Problem**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89175&key=user_uploads/859217/57361321-c472-4677-955d-e6feecc21f04)

Finance teams who are responsible for balance reporting and transaction reconciliation often scramble at month end, don’t report at the frequency they’d like, or sacrifice reporting accuracy altogether.   

1. **ACCOUNT INVENTORY**: Using multiple banks can mean liquidity is an unknown, especially for teams who work with many accounts. Bank accounts tracked in Excel—many unnamed or vaguely labeled—makes effective management nearly impossible. Often accounts are missed, and cash misplaced. 
2. **MANAGING ACCESS**: Financial operations are severely hindered by fragmented bank access scattered across multiple team members. Accountants regularly need separate logins, deal with constant lockouts, and navigate multiple security code requests, reducing productivity. Add in payment approval workflows, and you have duplicate, complex permissions to manage across multiple portals. 
3. **DATA NORMALIZATION**: Beyond data access, when teams finally gather transaction data across banks, the data comes through in various formats. Many banks only offer PDF downloads, some banks don’t even provide export.  
4. **TRANSFER MONITORING**: Teams need to log into multiple portals to monitor pending transactions and approvals. Additionally, when vendor or investor bank details change, they need to update the information across multiple portals.

 

Teams who have tried to solve this problem have found treasury software that doesn’t work for multibank users. Incumbent solutions price with bank-by-bank implementation, which doesn’t work for users who have hundreds of accounts across 10+ banks, with their account and bank list constantly in flux. 

  

# 👩‍💻  **Our Solution: One login for all finance teams needs**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89175&key=user_uploads/859217/7bf3d96a-04c3-4687-b9a6-6d369a929170)

  

We’ve built a dashboard for finance teams to interact in one place. When teams are doing the same manual tasks 10+ times, why not do them once? 

### STABLE CONNECTIONS

We leverage various connection methods to banks to provide stable, usable data daily to our customers. The account, balance, and activity information is the foundation to all workflows for our customers; unifying this information into a single place gives them back time for month-end reporting, peace of mind, and full transparency of their true cash flow.  

### DASHBOARD CUSTOMIZATION

We offer added customization to help organize account, balance, and activity data. Our dashboard is built around teams with complex fund and entity structures and prioritizes easy navigation according to how our users think about their bank information. 

### SINGLE PORTAL ACCESS

With payment approval workflows and read-only access, finance teams no longer need to permission non-account signers into bank portals. Finance teams can conduct their day-to-day operations without needing to log into 10+ portals to make payments or pull activity. 

  

Whether you are the controller sending investor distributions and paying vendors, an executive who wants a headline snapshot of cash, or an accountant reconciling transactions, Arpari saves you time. 

  

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89175&key=user_uploads/859217/a04f6c1b-0560-4b46-88f3-006cef73f664)

To solve this problem we’re first automating the process of verifying income and employment data for large property managers. Over time we plan to integrate with many data sources so payroll data can be seamlessly used to make better & faster underwriting decisions by any financial institution.

I started my career working at Goldman for 4 years, before making the jump to startup-land as the 4th employee at a proptech startup, where we processed online rental applications.  Seeing up close how broken the income verification process is, and how broken the overall way underwriters decide who gets access to housing (credit scores), lead us to realize there’s a better way.

Max started his career as one of the first engineers on the income verification team at Blend, spending years working on this problem before making the jump to work on search at Google.  After experiencing both the excitement of being early at a rapidly scaling startup (Blend is now public), and the mega-scale of search at Google, Max and I decided we were the team to tackle the broken consumer underwriting system.

Our biggest focus today is getting more customers, **so if you know anyone managing thousands of rental properties we would love an intro!**

# 🚀 Wand Solar — Bill Tenants for Solar Energy Like a Utility

👋 Hi everyone! We’re Idan and Itai, co-founders of **Wand Solar**.

## 🔥 The Problem

**Solar wasn’t built for rentals.**

Today, landlords invest in solar systems for their rental properties, but **tenants get all the savings**.

Landlords pay tens of thousands upfront—and see no return. ❌

We spoke with dozens of landlords who installed solar on their house, but when they moved out and kept it as a rental, they had **no way to bill their tenants** and recoup their investment.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CW7_9W_ZDmI>

## ⚡ What We’re Building

**Wand lets landlords bill tenants for solar energy—just like a utility.**

* 💰 Tenants pay what they normally would for electricity (or less)
* 🏠 Landlords finally earn from the solar systems they paid for
* ⚡ Same utility line items and tariffs. Full transparency
* ✨ Want to offer a deal? Set your own discount (e.g., 10%, 15%)
* 💳 Tenants pay by credit card—just like any other utility
* 🏦 Landlords get paid via wire transfer

**_No additional hardware. No tenant disruption. Just new income from the sun._**

**_You earn first, we only earn when you do_** - we charge 10% of the solar revenue you collect.

## 🔄 How It Works

1. **Add your property and connect your solar system -** just enter basic property info and link your solar setup.
2. **We track solar usage in 15-minute intervals -** we measure how much solar energy your tenants use—accurately, throughout the month.
3. **We generate monthly solar bills using your utility’s rates -** the bills reflect the same line items and tariffs your utility company uses.
4. **Tenants receive transparent, familiar-looking bills -** nothing confusing—just clear, itemized solar billing that looks like a standard utility bill.
5. **Tenants pay, you get paid -** tenants pay by card, you receive automatic transfers. You keep 90%, we take 10%.

## 💡 Why We Built This

Before Wand, we built a DevOps startup together. But we wanted to work on something with deeper impact—something that could actually move the needle on climate.

Then we saw this stat:

**55% of electricity in the U.S. is used in rental properties.**

Yet solar adoption in rentals is almost nonexistent—because of the **split incentive problem**: landlords pay for solar, but tenants get the savings.

It’s a broken system. And it’s a massive opportunity—both for reducing carbon emissions and unlocking billions in untapped properties across the entire value chain.

We built Wand to fix it. Now, landlords can finally earn from solar, and tenants still benefit from clean, affordable energy. Win-win.

This poses a huge challenge for companies (and in particular DevOps and Platform Engineers) to ensure CI/CD pipelines are up to security, quality and compliance standards.

**70% of the expenses made by Young Professionals are Shared!**

People in the early stages of their career usually shift to the tier 1 & 2 cities of India where their companies are based. In these cities, they live with their friends in shared apartments and have a lot of common expenses such as → Rent, House-Help, Cook, Groceries, Online Food Ordering, Entertainment, Travel, and Utilities just to name a few. There are also a lot of alluring activities that they partake in with their friends & colleagues which just adds up to a big amount at the end of the month.

In all these scenarios there is usually only one person who pays, then he/she tracks/splits the amount, then constantly asks for their money back (only to get it back after 2 months), and in the entire duration they suffer a dent which disrupts their monthly budget and there is almost negligible savings (Gosh! Hi! We’re Steph and Leia, co-founders of Cambio.

**Problem**

There are many stakeholders in commercial real estate (landlord, LP investor, lender, property manager, etc.). At the center of them all is building data: leases, loan documents, environmental assessments, physical conditions reports, etc. Yet this data is analog, manually created and spread across thousands of PDFs and spreadsheets. Bottom line: there is no system of record weaving all stakeholders in commercial real estate together.

This makes mission critical workflows like capital planning and compliance painful. Teams rely on manual, expensive and fragmented consultant engagements, requiring thousands of team hours and millions of dollars in upfront cost, just to know where to take action in order to drive returns and impact across the portfolio. After years of manually hunting down utility data, sifting through static 100-page reports and building one-off financial models for every building in the portfolio, real estate managers are desperate for a better way.    

**Enter Cambio**

We’ve lived this painful user journey. That’s why we built Cambio - to disrupt and automate this process. We use LLMs and agentic workflows to reason across thousands of pages of building documents and help commercial real estate funds identify high-impact retrofits that drive cost savings, compliance and decarbonization. Our AI-based models empower cheaper, faster, and more intelligent data-driven decisions across hundreds or thousands of buildings at scale.

**Backstory**

We met as roommates at Stanford while pursuing our Masters degrees. On move-in day, we discovered we both worked in commercial real estate and joked over a glass of wine that we should team up to start a company together. The rest is history! 

We’re building the solution we wished we had across collectively two decades working at leading commercial real estate players like KKR, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan and Oxford Properties.  We’ve lived the pain point and are ready to deliver our solution to the market.

launches.tagline: Turn a 10-minute phone video of an open trench into engineering-grade documentation
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We're Julius, Cornelius and Roger — the founders of sizeless.

**TL;DR**

sizeless turns a smartphone video of an open trench into the documentation utilities and contractors are legally required to produce: a 3D model, CAD/BIM plans, and the quantities they bill from. Today that takes months and a surveyor. We do it in hours, from a video the crew films themselves.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114663&key=user_uploads/1260577/02c85a25-fa1a-43a2-ad56-6e571b257b37)

### **Problem ❌**

Everything under a street — gas, water, power, heat, fiber — must be documented when it is built or repaired. That documentation is still done by hand: schedule a surveyor, drive out, measure with a tape or a GPS rover, write it on paper, go back to the office and draw it. Then the next contractor does the same thing again, for their own pipe, in the same trench.

Our average customer **waits 6 months** for documentation and spends around **$4M a year per German city** on it.

And once the trench is backfilled, nobody can check whether the numbers were right. One person's reading, one moment, unrepeatable. That is why crews keep hitting lines that "aren't there".

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114663&key=user_uploads/1260577/f446f4ae-943d-4c83-ba7e-c48b9220eca7)

### **Solution ✅**

The crew films the open trench with a phone for about 10 minutes. Then:

**Our SLAM engine** builds a metric 3D model from that video — no surveyor, no scanner, and it works without GPS in basements and house connections

**Our vision engine** recognises the components — pipe types, diameters, fittings, couplings — and attributes them

**Our agent** produces what the customer actually files: CAD/BIM, GIS, quantities, and invoice-ready numbers

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114663&key=user_uploads/1260577/bbaddb8c-abbf-43ad-8866-025cde7bb93b)

The crew also talks while filming, and that goes into the record:

> _"There was a gas pipe crossing, so we had to lay this pipe approximately\
> 50 cm below it."_

No point cloud and no plan ever captures the _reason_ for a deviation — and once the trench is closed, it is gone for good. That sentence, anchored to the exact position in 3D, is the part nobody else has.

**Where we are:** seven paid pilots in three months, the first converted to an annual contract, working with utilities and contractors on district heating in Germany.

**Why now:** phones do metric 3D capture, reconstruction got cheap, and vision-language models read attributes rather than just detecting boxes. And the long game: construction robots are coming, and nobody holds the training data for what is underground. That is the layer we are building.

### **Ask 💬**

**Intros to utilities, municipal works, or civil and pipeline contractors** - Europe or the US

**Anyone who has sold into municipalities or utilities:** how did you shorten those cycles?

**Founders in construction tech, geospatial or robotics** — would love to compare notes

If you know someone running a **family construction business**, that is often our fastest door in

You can reach us at [julius@sizeless.co](mailto:julius@sizeless.co) (commercial) or [cornelius@sizeless.co](mailto:cornelius@sizeless.co) (technical).

### **Team**

**Julius** (CEO) — ex-Chief of Staff to the CEO at Aon.

**Cornelius** (CTO) — PhD in robotics and computer vision at ETH Zürich's Autonomous Systems Lab. Built perception systems for railways, and a wearable navigation system for blind users.

**Roger** (Science lead) — professor of physics & AI. Spent a decade recovering 3D structure from sparse, noisy measurements; in his case, mapping the universe.

_Fun fact: the hardest part of our capture pipeline is not the maths, it is that trenches are wet, muddy, and full of moving excavators — which breaks every off-the-shelf 3D reconstruction method we tried._

launches.tagline: Meet Foundation — Shopify for Homebuilders
launches.body:
### Homebuilding: A huge industry that’s still offline

Homebuilding — building and selling new-construction homes — is a massive business. In the U.S., the Top 300 builders alone sell \~$250 billion worth of homes each year.

Not only is homebuilding a meaningful part of the U.S. economy, but it’s also a big part of U.S. culture (at least once you get out of Silicon Valley and NYC). In most American cities, most homeowners have either considered buying a new construction home, have already bought one, or know someone who works in or around the new construction industry.

The U.S. is also significantly underbuilt from a housing perspective — estimates suggest that we’re anywhere from 2M-6M homes short of the inventory needed to house American families. To bridge this gap, it’s going to be the big “production” builders who do much of the heavy lifting.

### The opportunity: bring a massive industry online

Despite how central homebuilding is to the U.S. economy & culture, large parts of the industry run almost entirely offline. After working closely with homebuilder partners for years at Opendoor, Foundation’s [founding team](https://www.linkedin.com/company/foundation-tech/) realized how big of an opportunity this is.

A simple question we ask: “Why do you have an app for tracking your pizza delivery, but not one for the biggest purchase of your life?” With [the launch of Foundation’s buyer experience platform](https://buildwithfoundation.com/), this finally changes.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78242&key=user_uploads/17250/224f88b6-3d32-435a-b9c9-90fd77e1ef64)

By bringing the home purchase and ownership experience online, Foundation’s buyer experience platform helps homebuilders sell more homes, at higher margins, to happier buyers.

Our first customers go live in Q1 2024, and the early response we’ve gotten — everyone from leading national builders who sell tens of thousands of homes a year, to forward-thinking, fast-growing regional and local builders — shows the tide is finally turning.

**Tl;dr:** We can increase a real estate owner’s property values by 20 percent in less than three months. We already have thousands of units on board and just signed a strategic partnership deal with a company that puts us in front of 8M units in 2026.

We’re [Alvin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alvinsalehi/) & [Greg](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gregrami/) and we’re the founders of [Goldbridge](https://www.goldbridgebanking.com/). Alvin’s first YC company, Shef (W19), is a homemade food marketplace that helped change state laws across the country so that people could legally cook and sell food from home. They raised over $100M, scaled Shef nationally, and built it into a Series B company that continues to grow rapidly across the country.

Now we’re building Goldbridge, the financial operating system for real estate – and we built it from the ground up based on our personal experience owning and operating residential properties.

**THE PROBLEM**

Over **$1 trillion** **of rent** flows through landlords’ bank accounts every year, and nearly 25% of it sits idle in reserves and deposits. In other words, **real estate banking is fundamentally broken**:

* Traditional banks don’t understand real estate cashflows
* Property management systems don’t handle money movement, treasury, or yield
* Operators juggle multiple bank accounts, spreadsheets, and manual reconciliations
* Billions are lost every year in missed yield, overpayments, and operational inefficiencies

This is one of the largest underserved financial categories in the country.

**WHY WE BUILT GOLDBRIDGE**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95598&key=user_uploads/95578/286eb9a4-254e-43a5-b09c-1e451fbb85ce)

As the son of immigrants, Alvin grew up in a motel and helped his parents manage properties growing up. Now he owns 81 units in the Bay Area, and he’s personally experienced how painful it is to manage property finances once you hit mid-market scale (50+ units).

By modernizing his banking stack, renegotiating contracts, appealing his property tax bills, applying for government rebates, optimizing maintenance spend, and restructuring rent collections, Alvin took his 81-unit portfolio from **–2% burn → +36% cashflow in just a few months.**

We’ve now replicated this for other property owners, and the patterns are universal.

**OUR SOLUTION**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95598&key=user_uploads/95578/de43ac4b-4268-4af9-8522-7410002f340c)

**1. Banking Built for Real Estate**

High yield operating accounts, reserve accounts, and automated reconciliations across your entire portfolio of properties -- all under one FDIC-backed infrastructure.

**2. Automated Savings & Earnings Optimization**

Goldbridge automatically surfaces:

* Property-tax reassessment opportunities
* Vendor contract renegotiation opportunities
* Government rebate and incentive programs
* Utility bill errors
* Idle cash yield optimization
* Reserve allocation improvements

Because Goldbridge sits at the **banking + transaction layer**, we have access to data that is cleaner, richer, and more accurate than generic financial platforms. On top of that, we can actually move money for owners intelligently and safely rather than just highlighting the issues that need to be resolved and throwing the manual work back onto their plates.

**WHY NOW**

**1. A $2.5T Refi Wall Is Coming (2027–2028)**

An estimated $2.5 trillion in real estate loans will mature soon, which is making owners desperate to improve their property finances. They will need pristine financials, liquidity discipline, and real-time visibility into how their money moves.

**2. LLMs Unlock Automation in a Data-Dense Industry**

Needless to say, real estate produces massive amounts of invoices, leases, utility bills, tax docs, contracts, rent rolls, and loan agreements. What previously took days to review and reconcile can now be done in minutes.

**TRACTION**

We’re moving extremely fast. We already have **thousands of units** on board and just signed a strategic partnership deal with a company that puts us in front of **8M units** in 2026.

* 15+ yrs eng experience with Data/ML/SWE; full stack + mobile native
* Built parallel data processing for physics models @ NIST

**GET IN TOUCH**

Goldbridge is building the financial OS for a trillion-dollar vertical. Drop us a line anytime if you’d like to chat – [**founders@goldbridgebanking.com**](mailto:founders@goldbridgebanking.com).

<https://youtu.be/RHqxOSwp-VU>

The US needs 100x more EV charging stations to be installed in the next 10 years if gasoline cars will be replaced by EVs. Rather than leaving this work up to the oil companies, who will drag their feet, we think blitzscaling charging needs to be done right, and done soon. 

As with most real estate, not all locations are created equal. It’s hard to predict which potential installation sites will see high utilization and profitability. What’s more, running an installation process in commercial environments (like multifamily apartment buildings or condos) is complicated and overwhelming.

### **Our Solution:**

 We are empowering the hard-working electricians of the world to not only solve the charging gap, but also be financially rewarded for doing so. We built magical software that can help analyze millions of candidate charging station locations for profitability, and manage the installation process – everything from permitting and contracts to material and labor management. We built integrations with over 30 different EVSE manufacturers, so that you can operate different charging station models all from one dashboard.  

After installation, operating a charging station business does require some ongoing work – stations need to be regularly inspected, updated, and retail prices need to be adjusted for fluctuations in energy prices.  Starlight’s all-in-one platform streamlines this part of the business for you.  Just like a vending machine, as people use your charging stations, you’ll collect small amounts of revenue day-after-day.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87003&key=user_uploads/157923/0f3aa3f4-742c-4b3c-ba9c-92a4882d5d23)

We have spent several years honing our own EV charging station operation through [Starlight Charging](http://www.starlightcharging.com/) – we have installed and operate ports all across the country. Through this process, we not only built custom software, but we discovered that electricians are in a unique position to profitably install and run the charging stations themselves.

**Why Electricians?**

First, a large majority of the installation cost is labor. Electricians can install stations during off-peak times, meaning they’ll keep their team busy now, investing in recurring revenue for later. Next, unlike nontechnical folk, electricians understand how these systems operate – it’s their bread and butter. Finally, if a charging station goes offline and needs maintenance, a locally-based station owner can get them repaired sooner – the incentives to keep the stations operating reliably are aligned!

Hi! We are Lucas and Paul, cofounders of Tire Swing: the AI compliance platform for Affordable Housing.

<https://youtu.be/x4qyhXXz38I>

## **The Problem**

Every Affordable Housing move-in and recertification requires applicant income verification and a strict eligibility review. In addition to the high labor costs and regulatory burden, delays in reviewing applications and thoroughly screening applicants can cause weeks of lost rental revenue.

Lost revenue on a single move-in can accumulate to thousands of dollars, and penalties for non-compliance can cost millions in credit recaptures and fines.

## **The Solution**

Tire Swing uses AI to bring compliance expertise to the point of leasing. It turns weeks of reviews and approvals into a minutes-long process. The platform:

* **Reviews evidence as it is collected.** Tire Swing processes documentation in minutes, allowing problems to be addressed before the applicant leaves the office.
* **Performs the eligibility analysis.** It calculates household income, applies all applicable property, state, and program eligibility rules, and links every finding to its supporting evidence.
* **Automates certification compliance.** Tire Swing flags missing, inconsistent, or incorrect information with steps to resolve the problem from a library of thousands of deterministic and AI driven compliance checks.

**Tire Swing means faster move-ins and recertifications, reduced consulting budget, and more consistent, audit-ready files.** 

## **Looking ahead**

We believe Affordable Housing is the first application of a much larger needs-based eligibility opportunity. Federal, state, and local governments distribute more than $1.5 trillion annually through needs-based programs including Medicaid, SNAP, TANF, utility assistance, and tax credits.

These programs share a common underlying workflow: collect documents, convert them into structured facts, apply eligibility rules, and resolve missing or contradictory information.  The administration costs for these services are approximately $20B annually.

## **The Team**

Tire Swing is founded by Paul and Lucas, college friends and Princeton computer science graduates. Prior to founding Tire Swing, Lucas worked as a software engineer at Instacart and Capital One, and Paul worked as a cybersecurity consultant at Stroz Friedberg.

launches.body:
<https://youtu.be/5IY3vHEJ7J4>

Construction has a mapping problem. Of the $2.2T in annual US construction spending, $150B is wasted due to a lack of subsurface knowledge. All construction starts from the ground up, and more often than not, unexpected assets underneath the surface will hold a construction project back. Whether it's an unknown utility line, unexpected rock layer, or old foundation that wasn’t on any design map, the costs of delays from underground conflicts quickly add up. 

Take utility strikes, when an excavator hits an active utility line. For every dollar spent on the explicit repair cost of that utility line itself, the contractor loses an additional $30 per repair-dollar in project delays, insurance claims, idle work crews, and increased insurance premiums. For a hyperscale project such as data center construction, a single day of delay can cost the cloud-provider up to $14 million dollars for that single day.

In metropolitan areas, maps are incomplete at best and none create a unified picture of critical infrastructure, making excavation especially dangerous when natural gas or electric lines are broken.

Enter SubVysion. We’ve built a fleet of autonomous rovers carrying ground-penetrating radar and other sensors that create a centimeter-accurate map of subsurface infrastructure. Our hardware is the first and the best to map the entirety of US infrastructure. Using our rovers, we comprehensively map construction sites, city streets, and even larger indoor buildings, at 100x better granularity and 10x the speed (with a single rover) compared to our competitors. We process vast amounts of data using machine learning and agents, and output that data into an easy-to-understand 3D scene. 

Who are we? Maxwell Stone was an early ML engineer at Roboflow (YC S20), and Wenson Tang built the world’s smallest and cheapest LiDAR-capable drone for adverse environments. We both studied computer science at the University of Pennsylvania. Together, we’re building SubVysion to map the entirety of America’s subsurface infrastructure.

We’re currently on job sites in Philadelphia and Texas, helping our first market of utility contractors save hundreds of thousands of dollars every year. We’re soon to expand our mapping services to municipalities and energy providers as we scale up our rover fleet and capacity!

If you’re in the energy, infrastructure, or hyperscale construction world, we’d love to hear from you at [founders@subvysion.com](mailto:founders@subvysion.com)!
